question: What worship is to be begun after the arghya placement in this procedure?
premises: The procedure moves to the next rite.
That rite is named as worship of the seat.
inference: One should begin the worship of the seat (pīṭha-pūjā).
uncertainties: The full components of pīṭha-pūjā are specified in surrounding verses.
plain_english: One should begin the worship of the seat.
